paragraphs: Before takeoff, the pilot reviews weather and load and prepares the flight plan. After taxi and takeoff, autopilot handles cruise while the pilot monitors. Turbulence or restricted airspace can require a route change. The pilot manually stabilizes descent, approach, and landing, then completes the flight log and hands over the aircraft.

In short, Commercial Pilots fly aircraft safely to their destinations. They plan routes, perform takeoffs and landings, monitor instruments, respond to weather, inspect aircraft, and maintain flight records. The role combines analysis with hands-on control.
